UK Man Quits Chemo and Beats Cancer with Cannabis

Quitting chemo was dumb, but cannabinoids have been proven to shrink tumors when injected right into them. It's fairly well known and accepted in the UK at least, my grandad had a similar treatment a year or so ago. I know you're meant to keep an eye on the tumor still as it hasn't stopped growing really, it's just smaller, but they do often stop growing after treatment.

That said quitting chemo was stupid, he basically took a gamble he didn't know the real odds for. He's lucky to have won and hopefully people take note of how this treatment can work without chemo for some people but a guy didn't need to risk death to find that out.
I've seen family go through chemo. His attitude may have been "I'm not going to do chemo any more." and opted to either pass away or try this before he went.

I've seen chemo with a few relatives. It's a nightmare of a task, a real life nightmare that goes on for weeks at a time.

I still wouldn't give up on chemo though, killing a tumor while killing you and hoping it goes first is the mission. You can't give up on that because you have a plan to make it weaker, you do both at once and double your chances! You don't hurt your odds on a shot in the dark.
I agree that your approach greatly improves the odds, but I watched I family member go because they refused to do any more chemo. I suspect that was the same reasoning they had.
